title: lane r2 SE: fix-discovered-while-implementing has no precedence rule
description: Lane round 2. Lens: software-engineer (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: a defect found and fixed mid-layer is simultaneously layer work and fix-lane work — two gates, two baselines, two compositions, no precedence; 'before implementation' impossible for discovery-during-build. Citations verified: contract:64, :81, :89. Proposed: resolved-candidate (defects in code the current layer is building are layer work — finding filed, routed to the layer issue, layer red gate governs; the fix lane governs code outside the current layer's build scope; filing precedes the fix's implementation in both).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: precedence stated — defects in code the current layer is building are layer work (finding files at discovery, routes to the layer issue, layer red gate governs); the fix lane governs code outside the current layer's build scope; filing precedes the fix's implementation in both. Revision: Finding lifecycle bullet.
